Vitamin B Complex

Vitamin energy nervous-system adrenal-support mood

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

B-complex group of B vitamins; essential for energy metabolism, nervous system function, and stress response.

Indications

  • fatigue
  • stress
  • adrenal exhaustion
  • mood disorders
  • nerve damage
  • digestive weakness
  • anemia

Contraindications

  • very rare B12 hypersensitivity

Preparations

  • capsule
  • tablet
  • sublingual

Body Systems Affected

  • nervous
  • endocrine
  • digestive
  • circulatory

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Insomnia & Sleep Disorders
    Sleep disorders characterized by difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or excessive daytime sleepiness, often related to stress and anxiety.
